name: crash_once_heal
description: Crashes the backend (raw-thread null-deref) on the FIRST process() of a fresh on-disk instance, dropping a .crashed_once.marker file in its instance folder; on every later backend start the marker is present so it runs healthy. Deterministic fixture for FE-E5 (crash once then heal across a respawn). Marker survives the process restart; the driver deletes it before each run.

outputs.name: count
outputs.doc: Frames processed since this (healed) backend start.

outputs.name: healed
outputs.doc: Always true on the non-crash path; absent when the backend died mid-frame.
